sender: City Parking Services, 410 Oakmont Plaza, Suite 2, Fairview Glen, CA 91299
headline: This is a $73 street sweeping parking ticket with some mistakes on it.
summary: You got a ticket for parking on a street sweeping day. The ticket says your car is a Honda, but the officer's note says Toyota Camry. The officer's name and ID are also blank. These mistakes may help you contest it.

deadline.what_is_due: Pay the $73 or contest the ticket. The ticket says you can ask for an initial review within 21 days of the issue date (11/09/2026), which is {{DATE:+16}}.

if_ignored: A late penalty of $73 is added, making it $146. A hold may be placed on your vehicle registration with the DMV. You could also lose your right to contest.

action_steps.title: Check your car and your photos
action_steps.detail: Is your car a silver Honda with plate 8ABC123? Or a Toyota Camry? Take photos of the car and the plate.

action_steps.title: Check the street signs
action_steps.detail: Go to the 1200 block of Maple Grove Ave, north side. Photograph the signs near the curb and at the corner. Note if they are missing, blocked, or confusing.

action_steps.title: Ask for an initial review
action_steps.detail: Do this soon, not on the last day. Include citation number FG-4471902, your photos, and the appeal letter in this report.
action_steps.contact: www.cityparkingservices-sample.org/contest, phone (818) 555-0172 (Mon–Fri, 8 AM–5 PM), or mail to 410 Oakmont Plaza, Suite 2, Fairview Glen, CA 91299

action_steps.title: Keep proof
action_steps.detail: Save copies of everything you send and any confirmation number. If you call, write down the date and the person's name.

action_steps.title: If you decide not to contest, pay on time
action_steps.detail: Pay $73 by {{DATE:+16}} to avoid the late penalty. Do not send cash.

action_steps.title: If denied, ask for a hearing
action_steps.detail: If the initial review is denied, you can ask for an administrative hearing (a meeting where a neutral person reviews your case). You may need to pay first or show you cannot afford to. Check the denial notice for the deadline.

red_flags.text: The vehicle make box says HONDA, but the officer's remarks say Toyota Camry. One of these is wrong.
The issuing officer name / ID number is blank.
The ticket does not give the exact sign wording. The remarks only say a sign was posted at the corner.

reasons: It has a citation number, location, time and violation code.
It explains how to contest and pay.
It does not ask for gift cards, wire transfers or crypto, and it says not to send cash.
To be safe, confirm the website and phone number on the issuing city's official website before paying.

ticket.violation: FGMC 10.36.120 — Street sweeping: no parking 8 AM–10 AM on posted sweeping day
missing_or_wrong_fields: Issuing officer name / ID number is blank
Vehicle make conflict: HONDA in the vehicle box, but 'Toyota Camry' in officer remarks
Exact sign wording and location are vague; remarks say only 'sign posted at corner'
Location is a block range ('1200 block'), not an exact address
possible_grounds: Vehicle make does not match: the ticket lists two different makes, so it may not describe your car.
Missing officer name/ID, so the ticket cannot be verified.
[Confirm: the sweeping sign was missing, blocked, faded or not visible from where you parked. Attach photos.]
[Confirm: the sign was only at the corner, not along the block where you parked.]
[Confirm: your car was not there, or you had already sold it.]
[Confirm: sweeping was cancelled that day, for example for a holiday or rain.]
ticket.contest_strength_reason: The ticket itself has clear defects: two different vehicle makes (Honda vs. Toyota Camry) and no officer name or ID. These are good reasons to ask for dismissal.
